fullContentHtml:
UIICL Administrative Officers AO Phase-I Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

United India Insurance Company Limited (UIIC) has released the Admit Card for the post of Administrative Officers (AO) Scale-I (Generalist and Hindi Officer). This recruitment was released for 255 posts. Applications for the UIICL Administrative Officers AO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 08 September 2026, to 01 October 2026. The online examination is going to be conducted on 22 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UIICL Administrative Officers AO Phase-I Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 08 September 2026
  • Last Date : 01 October 2026
  • Last Date of Fee Payment : 01 October 2026
  • Phase-I Exam Date : 22 October 2026
  • Phase-II Admit Card : 15 October 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 30 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC / ST / PH : Rs. 250/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Important Links

  • Download Phase-I Admit Card
  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UIICL Administrative Officers AO Phase-I Admit Card 2026?

UIICL Administrative Officers AO Phase-I Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
